items.title: Charles "Creole Charlie" Levy Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: I gave Feather and Gill 30 records, old records, Joe Olive and all the old records. And he was supposed to give them back to me.

ctx.x: Yeah, the collectors are very much interested in that because Ruben did so well. One of them he imitated Louie. Yeah, yes. And they call him River Reeves because he did it so well.

Did you know Feather and Gill was here? Yes. Yes. I gave Feather and Gill 30 records, old records, Joe Olive and all the old records. And he was supposed to give them back to me. He was gonna record and do something and give them back to me and I've lost track of the man. He's in New York.
Somebody said he was in San Diego. Well, he's traveling around a little and he's in artwork now.
